csv_project_name: Engineering For Gero Park Multipurpose Court Resurfacing
csv_scope_of_work: The Township of Millburn is soliciting qualifications for professional engineering services relating to the resurfacing and renovation of the existing multipurpose court located in Gero Park, Millburn, New Jersey. The Township is seeking qualified engineering firms to provide design, evaluation, bid assistance, and construction administration services for the improvement of the existing court surface. The Township is considering multiple resurfacing options including, but not limited to, asphalt resurfacing, post-tension concrete construction, or an overlay system applied to the existing surface, depending on site conditions and overall construction costs.
